units.source_text: 左大臣家诸公子，个个忠厚诚笃，重用于世。

en.t: The sons of the Minister of the Left were all loyal, sincere, and highly valued in the world.

units.source_text: 过去无忧无虑，荣华度日；

en.t: In the past, they lived without worry or care, passing their days in splendor.
But now every one of them was dispirited.

units.source_text: 与源氏大将最为亲近的三位中将等，在政界尤为失势。

en.t: The Third-Rank Captain and the others who had been closest to General Genji had lost influence in court politics most of all.

units.source_text: 三位中将过去虽然时时赴四女公主处留宿，

en.t: Although the Third-Rank Captain had formerly gone from time to time to spend the night with the fourth princess,

units.source_text: 但因对妻子一向态度冷淡，所以右大臣也不把他归入爱婿之列，以示报复。

en.t: because he had always treated his wife coldly, the Minister of the Right refused to count him among his favored sons-in-law, as a form of retaliation.

units.source_text: 大约三位中将早有自知之明，所以此次不得升官晋爵，亦不甚介意。

en.t: The Third-Rank Captain had probably long understood his own position, and so he did not much mind failing to receive promotion or a higher rank this time.

units.source_text: 他看见源氏大将都已笼闭在家，可知世事已不可为，则自己的不遇乃当然之事。

en.t: Seeing that even General Genji had shut himself away at home, he understood that worldly affairs could no longer be helped, and that his own lack of success was only natural.

units.source_text: 他就常常访晤源氏大将，与他共研学问，或合奏弦管。

en.t: He therefore often visited General Genji, studying with him or playing strings and pipes together.

units.source_text: 以前这两人常常狂热地互相竞争，现在还是如此，些微小事亦必互相较量，借此消磨岁月。

en.t: These two had often competed passionately with each other before, and they still did so now, measuring themselves against one another even in trifles and passing the days in this way.
